name: books-management-monorepo
description: Hệ thống Quản lý Sách Thư viện - Monorepo Vue 3 + Express + MongoDB

scripts.install:all: npm install && npm --prefix backend install && npm --prefix frontend-user install && npm --prefix frontend-admin install
scripts.dev: concurrently -n "BACKEND,USER,ADMIN" -c "blue,green,magenta" "npm run dev:backend" "npm run dev:user" "npm run dev:admin"
